audio_description:
Galbadia Garden drives into Balamb Garden's entrance.
The structures smash together in twisting metal and energy.

context.scene_title: The Gardens crash together — the violent collision climax of the Battle of the Gardens (Disc 2).
locations: Balamb Garden's entrance gate and the point of impact between the two Gardens
context.summary: Galbadia Garden drives into Balamb Garden's entrance, and the two structures smash together in a chaos of twisting ornate metal and red-and-blue magical energy — the crashing climax of the Garden battle.
